title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support to electoral violence prevention and mitigation of regional tensions

description.narrative: Ethiopia is grappling with a volatile political climate, persisting tensions and violence in the four key regions of Tigray, Afar, Amhara and Oromia. The approach of the general elections, scheduled for June 2026, carries a risk of violence due to ongoing regional conflicts and tensions, and to the ethnic and political fragmentation and restricted civic and media spaces. The Amhara region has been deeply embroiled in conflict between federal forces and the Fano militia since mid-2023. The fighting has resulted in widespread displacement, disrupted livelihoods, and severely constrained humanitarian access. This 18-month exceptional assistance measure focuses on mitigating electoral violence risks, and supporting dialogue and stabilisation efforts in Amhara. It aims to foster inclusive pre- and post-election dialogue among key political and electoral stakeholders and engage in community-level dialogue, particularly with youth, to bridge societal divisions and counteract political violence. In Amhara, the action aims to leverage coordinated efforts with international and national partners, to promote violence reduction, stability and improved living conditions for conflict-affected communities in the region.
